module.name: Stingy Scanner by Digizaal
module.description: Built by a Dutch web agency managing 600+ websites on dedicated 130 GB Plesk servers. Monitor every hosted site for malware, phishing and spam using the VirusTotal API and Google Safe Browsing — without burning your daily API quota. Smart caching, budget control and nightly background scanning keep every site covered. Detects rogue WordPress admin accounts per site: flags suspicious usernames, free-email addresses, recently added accounts and foreign email domains, checks every admin email against XposedOrNot for known data breaches, and lets you delete or reset passwords directly from the panel.
